notes.title: V1.0.1.7 Major Art Update

tags.feature: 【New Feature】Voidwalker Artifact: Every 6 summons, additionally summon a random creature
【New Feature】Warrior Artifact, Earthshaker Hammer: When picking up a rune, release a shockwave that stuns nearby enemies for 2 seconds
【New Feature】Warrior Artifact, Secret Technique: Breath of Thunder: When using an attack card, envelop yourself in lightning, dealing Lightning Damage to nearby enemies and applying Shock
【New Feature】Right-click to quickly use the last card with a Return trait
【New Feature】Shop item locks will now persist

tags.balance_change: 【Value Optimization】The general artifact Whetstone now grants +5 attack to the first attack card on the left side of your hand every 10 seconds
【Value Optimization】Reduced the overall difficulty of Auto Chess Mode
【Value Optimization】Reduced the difficulty level 10 of Strategic Mode

tags.bug: 【Value Optimization】The damage from elite archer mobs and the Felfire Trap will now scale with difficulty (previously fixed)

tags.balance_change: 【Balance Adjustment】Mage attack card, Lightning Strike, damage increased from 100 to 200
【Balance Adjustment】Mage skill card, Mass Draw, cost increased from 5 to 8
【Balance Adjustment】Voidwalker's skill card, Summon Golem, changed from granting 50 armor to all allies after attacking 3 times to granting 150 armor to itself
【Balance Adjustment】Lowered the overall difficulty of Auto Chess Mode
【Balance Adjustment】Lowered the difficulty of Difficulty Levels 9 and 10 across all modes

tags.bug: 【Bug Fix】Fixed an issue with abnormal save settings

tags.feature: 【Performance Optimization】Optimized collision detection algorithm to improve game smoothness and reduce lag caused by too many monsters

tags.balance_change: 【Balance Adjustment】Universal Artifact: Draw Scroll triggers when the hand has less than or equal to 1 card instead of less than 0
【Balance Adjustment】Difficulty adjustments, difficulty level 7 and beyond have been lowered

tags.feature: 【Function Optimization】Resolution optimization, set the device's default resolution as the initial resolution

tags.bug: 【BUG Fixes】Fixed the issue where the artifact counter became invalid after summoning
【BUG Fixes】Fixed missing attack sound effects for summoned creatures
